cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing; a towering magic library where books drift slowly through the air between tall shelves — reads a glowing spellbook with drifting rune light held open in both hands; a photo studio with a seamless paper backdrop sweeping onto the floor — tilts a round gold-and-silver photo reflector to bounce light onto her face; overgrown jungle temple ruins — sitting on the ground; a neon-lit indoor late-night bowling alley with empty lanes and a glowing ball-return machine — she celebrates an unexpectedly lucky strike with a small satisfied smile while waiting for her ball to return; a sunny seaside boardwalk lined with palms — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a private outdoor saltwater flotation pool with white stone ledges and bright midday reflections — she reclines against a floating cushion and lifts the bottom of her dripping swim cover skirt to drain a little trapped pool water over the ledge; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an escape room dressed as an old study — standing close to a high shelf or line; the launch deck of a carrier ship of her world — perched on a ledge or edge; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a sunny bay behind a speedboat — chest-deep in the water
